name: Celia Lede
source:
Celia is an inside director for a very successful advertising firm.

Her entire life revolves around climbing the corporate ladder. She married her husband, Harold to exclusively further her own career.

The stress of her single-minded lifestyle has manifested into functional alcoholism and several violent tendencies.

[spoiler]At first, she satisfied the latter by watching illegal torture and murder streams online. However, it soon wasn't enough. When she was 29, she tricked an intern into following her into an abandoned office complex before brutally murdering him.
After two more interns disappeared in quick succession, the police began to ask questions. Celia managed to control her urges to avoid being found out - until a link to an auction appeared after one of her favorite streams.[/spoiler]
